result.finding: The application is a Maven-managed Java project with dependencies declared in pom.xml files. Dependencies are resolved at build time and bundled into Spring Boot fat JARs. The Dockerfiles copy only the pre-built JAR (COPY target/*.jar app.jar) — no package manager runs inside the container. Both modules share the Spring Boot 2.7.18 parent BOM for version management.
evidence: Generated Dockerfiles: 'COPY target/*.jar app.jar' — fat JAR packaging, no in-container Maven install
asset-manager/pom.xml: parent BOM spring-boot-parent 2.7.18, Java 8, two modules (web, worker)

web/pom.xml: 9 declared dependencies (spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-thymeleaf, spring-boot-starter-amqp, software.amazon.awssdk:s3:2.25.13, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, postgresql, lombok, spring-boot-devtools, spring-boot-configuration-processor)
worker/pom.xml: 7 declared dependencies (spring-boot-starter, spring-boot-starter-amqp, software.amazon.awssdk:s3:2.25.13, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, postgresql, lombok, jackson-databind)
Test scope (not in fat JAR): spring-boot-starter-test (JUnit 5, Mockito)
